name: Dayforce
description_en:
Dayforce is a cloud human-capital-management suite connecting HR records, payroll, workforce management, talent and analytics. The catalog’s former Ceridian product URL now redirects to the Dayforce suite website; this draft retains the original slug while updating the current product identity.

For HR evaluation, its central proposition is a shared employee record across functions. Scheduling and time management are operational components of the wider suite, while the purchased components, implementation scope and regional services need a specific sales agreement.
description_zh:
Dayforce 是连接 HR 档案、工资、人员运营管理、人才和分析的云端人力资本管理套件。目录原有 Ceridian 产品地址现已跳转到 Dayforce 套件官网，本稿更新当前产品身份，同时保留原 slug。

从 HR 角度评估，其核心在于跨功能共享员工档案。排班和工时管理属于更广套件的运营组件，实际购买组件、实施范围及地区服务需通过具体销售协议确认。

core_features.explanation_en: HR describes one employee record across the suite, with compensation, benefits, performance and organizational information.
core_features.explanation_zh: HR 页面描述跨套件共享档案，涵盖薪酬、福利、绩效和组织信息。

core_features.explanation_en: Workforce Management considers business demand, labor budget, worker preferences and pay rates when generating schedules.
core_features.explanation_zh: Workforce Management 在生成排班时考虑业务需求、人工预算、员工偏好和工资费率。

core_features.explanation_en: Authorized employees can update personal details, access pay and schedules, read communications and fill out forms.
core_features.explanation_zh: 获授权员工可更新个人资料、查看工资及排班、阅读通知和填写表单。

pricing.summary_en: Custom quote by workforce, components and complexity; implementation is scoped with sales. Generic market rates on the WFM FAQ are not Dayforce prices.
pricing.summary_zh: 按人员规模、组件和复杂度定制报价，实施与销售确定；人员运营 FAQ 的市场区间不是 Dayforce 价格。

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from the attached primary sources. Vendor documentation does not establish independent testing or customer outcomes.
Original directory feature labels were replaced with product-specific documented capabilities. Unknowns and unreviewed alternatives remain unknown.

sections.title_en: One suite, with a defined purchased scope
sections.title_zh: 共享套件仍需明确购买范围
sections.en: The former ceridian.com/products/dayforce address resolves to the current Dayforce suite page. The current vendor describes HR, pay, time, talent and analytics on one platform, and its HR FAQ says these capabilities share a codebase. That supports evaluating consistency across functions, but not assuming that every advertised module is included in a base subscription. Define whether the intended project covers core HR only, payroll, scheduling, benefits or talent. A country selector or broad global availability claim does not establish identical local payroll or benefit functionality in every country.
sections.zh: 原 ceridian.com/products/dayforce 地址跳转至当前 Dayforce 套件页。供应商现将 HR、工资、工时、人才和分析描述为同一平台，HR FAQ 说明这些能力使用共同代码基础。这支持评估跨功能数据一致性，却不代表所有宣传模块均含在基础订阅中。需先明确项目涵盖基础 HR、工资、排班、福利还是人才。国家选择器或广泛的全球可用性声明，不能证明各国的本地工资及福利功能完全相同。

sections.title_en: Trace a record change into the right views
sections.title_zh: 把档案变更追踪到相应视图
sections.en: An illustrative acceptance case is an employee changing department and manager. Check the employee record, organization view, authorized manager access and the relevant report, then inspect any payroll or scheduling consequence within the purchased configuration. HR documents self-service updates and reports spanning the suite, but permission boundaries and correction behavior were not tested. People Experience provides targeted communications, and benefits tools describe guided enrollment and comparisons; these should be scoped as actual components rather than inferred from the HR label alone.
sections.zh: 验收示例可以选择员工更换部门和经理：检查档案、组织视图、新经理权限及相关报表，再检查所购配置中的工资或排班影响。HR 文档说明可自助更新并跨套件报表分析，但本研究未测试权限边界或纠错行为。People Experience 提供面向不同受众的通知，福利工具描述引导参保和方案比较；这些应作为实际组件确认，不能仅凭 HR 名称推定已含。

sections.title_en: Connect coverage, time and labor budgets
sections.title_zh: 连接人员覆盖、工时与人工预算
sections.en: Workforce Management goes beyond an employee database: it describes demand forecasting, scheduling, time and attendance, absence management, labor planning and task assignment. Automatic scheduling considers demand, budgets, worker preferences and pay rates. For a frontline team, compare planned coverage with actual time and an unexpected absence before assessing unplanned overtime. This example is editorial guidance, not a measured saving. Time clocks and task-management options are separately described capabilities; compatibility with existing hardware, scheduling rules and the organization’s actual pay rules needs demonstration.
sections.zh: Workforce Management 超出员工数据库范围，包含需求预测、排班、工时考勤、缺勤、人工规划及任务分配。自动排班考虑需求、预算、员工偏好和工资费率。一线团队可比较计划覆盖、实际工时及一次意外缺勤，再评估非计划加班。这是编辑建议，没有测量节省金额。打卡设备和任务管理选项属于分别描述的能力，与既有硬件、排班规则及企业实际工资规则的兼容性仍需演示。

sections.title_zh: 已赚工资提前支取存在条件
sections.en: The HR page promotes Dayforce Wallet and access to earned wages during a pay cycle, but its footnote says employers may choose not to offer on-demand pay, and blackout dates and limits can depend on pay-cycle configuration. It should therefore not be listed as an unconditional benefit for every employee or every contract. For any payroll project, request written country, employer, bank-transfer and service eligibility details, then reconcile a normal pay period before evaluating optional early access. No payroll, payment transfer or Wallet transaction was performed here.
sections.zh: HR 页面宣传 Dayforce Wallet 及在发薪周期内支取已赚工资，但脚注明确雇主可以不提供提前支取，且不可用日期和限制取决于工资周期配置。因此不能将其列为每位员工或每份合同均无条件可用的福利。工资项目应取得国家、雇主、银行转账及服务资格的书面说明，先核对正常发薪周期，再评估可选提前支取。本研究未处理工资、转账或 Wallet 交易。

sections.en: Dayforce’s HR FAQ describes subscriptions affected by employee count, purchased components and organizational complexity, with representatives determining implementation scope and cost. The Workforce Management FAQ quotes a general market range of roughly $8–$40 per user per month, then explicitly directs Dayforce buyers to sales for a tailored estimate. That range is not Dayforce’s rate card. Use the official demo or sales route to obtain software, implementation, interfaces, training, support and regional service terms. No exact Dayforce price, minimum term or sustained free plan was verified in the reviewed sources.
sections.zh: Dayforce HR FAQ 说明订阅受员工人数、购买组件及组织复杂度影响，由销售确定实施范围和成本。Workforce Management FAQ 提到大约每用户每月 8–40 美元的一般市场区间，随后明确要求 Dayforce 买家向销售获取定制估算。该区间不是 Dayforce 的价目表。应通过官方演示或销售渠道取得软件、实施、接口、培训、支持及地区服务条款。所读来源未核实 Dayforce 的确切价格、最短期限或长期免费套餐。

sections.title_en: Treat adoption as a data and rule project
sections.title_zh: 把导入视为数据与规则项目
sections.en: Dayforce is worth considering when HR and frontline operations need shared records and coordinated time and pay processes. A team wanting a simple isolated employee list should consider the implementation effort before selecting the wider suite. Prepare identifiers, organization structure, access roles, balances and applicable local rules; reconcile reports and explicitly demonstrate a late timesheet or incorrect employee change. Data import, corrections, complete export, connector retries, retention and regional hosting remain untested. These sources establish a vendor-operated cloud offering, but not a self-hosted edition or an open-source license.
sections.zh: 需要共享档案并协调工时和工资流程的 HR 与一线运营团队，可以评估 Dayforce。只需独立员工列表的团队，应先衡量采用更广套件的实施工作。需准备编号、组织结构、权限、余额和适用本地规则，核对报表并明确演示迟交工时或错误档案变更。导入、纠错、完整导出、连接器重试、保留期限及地区托管均未测试。来源支持其为供应商运营的云服务，但未确立自托管版本或开源许可。
